item.title: High CPU: pollInstructions infinite retry loop on 404 for orgs without Copilot custom instructions
item.body:
## Summary

When a user belongs to a GitHub org that **has Copilot enabled but has not configured org-level custom instructions**, Copilot Chat enters an infinite retry loop calling `pollInstructions` → `getOrgCustomInstructions`. Each failed attempt returns HTTP 404, but the extension treats it as a transient error and retries indefinitely, causing one or more `Code Helper (Plugin)` processes to peg at 100–115% CPU.

## Environment

- **VS Code**: 1.109.3
- **GitHub Copilot Chat**: 0.37.6
- **OS**: macOS 15 (Apple Silicon M2)
- **Affected org**: any GitHub org with Copilot enabled but no custom instructions configured

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Be a member of a GitHub org that has Copilot enabled but **has not configured** org custom instructions (i.e. `GET /copilot_internal/org_custom_instructions/{org}` returns 404).
2. Open VS Code with GitHub Copilot Chat enabled.
3. Observe CPU usage in Activity Monitor — one or more `Code Helper (Plugin)` processes spike to 100%+.

## Root Cause

### API call

Copilot Chat polls the following internal endpoint on a tight loop:

```
GET https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/org_custom_instructions/{orgLogin}
```

When the org has no custom instructions, the API returns **HTTP 404**:

```json
{ "message": "Not Found", "status": "404" }
```

### Why the error message appears empty in logs

The request is made over **HTTP/2**, which does not transmit a reason phrase. As a result, `response.statusText` is an empty string `""`. The error is constructed as:

```js
throw new Error(`Failed to fetch custom instructions for org ${t}: ${o.statusText}`);
// → "Failed to fetch custom instructions for org myorg: "  ← empty after colon
```

This makes the log entry look like a network failure rather than a definitive 404, and the polling loop does not distinguish between transient errors and permanent ones.

### Relevant code path (`extension.js`)

```
pollInstructions(orgLogin)
  └─ octoKitService.getOrgCustomInstructions(orgLogin, { createIfNone: false })
       └─ capiClientService.makeRequest({ type: "OrgCustomInstructions", orgLogin })
            └─ fetch(`${dotComAPIURL}/copilot_internal/org_custom_instructions/${orgLogin}`)
                 → 404 → throws Error with empty statusText
  └─ catch(r) → logService.error(...)  ← no backoff, no stop, retries immediately
```

### Evidence from extension log

```
2026-02-16 18:22:10.859 [error] Error: Failed to fetch custom instructions for org myorg:
	at zL.getOrgCustomInstructions (.../github.copilot-chat-0.37.6/dist/extension.js:1523:9055)
	at async gG.pollInstructions (.../github.copilot-chat-0.37.6/dist/extension.js:1228:1174)

2026-02-16 18:22:24.312 [error] Error: Failed to fetch custom instructions for org myorg:
	at zL.getOrgCustomInstructions (.../github.copilot-chat-0.37.6/dist/extension.js:1523:9055)
	at async gG.pollInstructions (.../github.copilot-chat-0.37.6/dist/extension.js:1228:1174)
```

The loop fires every ~14 seconds. Over time, multiple extension host processes accumulate open file handles to Cline's MCP settings file as a side effect of each poll cycle.

## Expected Behavior

- A **404** response from `getOrgCustomInstructions` should be treated as a **definitive** result (org has no instructions), not a transient failure.
- The poller should **stop retrying** (or use a very long interval, e.g. hours) once a 404 is confirmed.
- At minimum, **exponential backoff with a cap** should be applied to avoid CPU saturation.

## Actual Behavior

- `pollInstructions` retries on every failure with no backoff.
- `Code Helper (Plugin)` processes reach 100–115% CPU on Apple Silicon.
- The extension host becomes sluggish for all other extensions sharing the same process.

## Workaround

Disable the org custom instructions feature in VS Code settings:

```json
"github.copilot.chat.experimental.externalAgentsEnabled": false
```

Or disable Copilot Chat entirely and re-enable only the core Copilot extension.

## Suggested Fix

In `getOrgCustomInstructions` / `pollInstructions`:

1. Catch HTTP 404 explicitly and **return `null`** (no instructions) instead of throwing.
2. On any non-transient HTTP error (4xx), **stop the polling loop** for that org.
3. Apply **exponential backoff** for transient errors (5xx, network failures).

## Related Issues

- [microsoft/vscode #267629](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/267629) — High CPU / "Extension host unresponsive" when Copilot Chat is enabled (closed, Windows, different version, but same symptom of Copilot Chat causing sustained high CPU that disappears when the extension is disabled)
- [community discussion #53846](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/53846) — Copilot VSCode Extension causes high CPU usage (general reports across versions)
- [community discussion #56755](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/56755) — GitHub Copilot High Resource Usage Bug Report
